title: feat: add usage and earnings breakdown tables
author: TopProjectsCreator
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds usage and earnings breakdown tables sorted by Pollen using existing account API responses.
- Shows Paid and Quest Pollen with request counts in icon badges, aligned dividers, and matching Total rows; earnings sources use neutral App/Model labels.
- Preserves filters and graphs, with one horizontally scrollable table per section, accessible column labels, and no row hover highlights.
- Removes the token/audio/video expansion and API/Tinybird changes from this PR.
- Validated with service typecheck, frontend build, Biome, and desktop/mobile local preview checks.

Addresses #12302

gist.headline: Where the Pollen went
gist.blurb: The account garden got some proper labels. Usage and earnings now break down by source, so every Paid and Quest Pollen grain has a place to stand.
gist.summary: Added horizontally scrollable usage and earnings breakdown tables in the account activity view, sorting rows by Pollen and showing Paid and Quest Pollen, request counts, totals, and neutral App/Model earnings sources using existing account API data.
gist.impact: Users can now see which apps or models account for their usage and earnings at a glance, with matching totals and filters and graphs still intact on desktop and mobile.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden accountant, comparing two cozy ledger tables: one for Pollen used and one for Pollen earned. Tiny app and model seedlings sit in labeled rows while a retro CRT companion displays simple bar graphs; Pollen grains, request badges, dividers, and a Total row make the new breakdowns tangible.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and tiny round accountant glasses, tending a lime green (#ecf874) Pollen ledger beside two neatly organized scrollable tables labeled in simple pixel font 'USAGE' and 'EARNINGS'; small app and model seedlings grow from each row while a friendly CRT monitor robot shows a gentle graph and flowers bloom around the desk. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
